@sergiordlr: This pull request explicitly references no jira issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/machine-config-operator/pull/6336):

>**- What I did**
>
>One of the possibilities being discussed to speed the extended tests execution is to parallelise the tests using custom worker pools.
>
>The number of possible parallel tests should be `num_workers - 1` in the cluster. 
>
>The problem is that the serial test cases should run in a N worker clusters, the more parallel test cases the more workers the serial tests will have to handle. The solution for that is to configure maxUnavailble = num_workers-1.
>
>The problem is that there are 3 test cases that manipulate the maxUnavailable value, and they don't restore the original value.
>
>In order to make the parallel option viable we modify those tests so that they restore the initial maxUnavailable value.
>
>
>**- How to verify it**
>
>All tests should pass
>


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Fmachine-config-operator).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

## Walkthrough Two extended MachineConfigPool tests now defer restoration of the complete original MCP spec after modifying `maxUnavailable`, replacing targeted removal cleanup. ### Changes **MachineConfigPool test cleanup** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Defer complete MCP spec restoration**
`test/extended-priv/mco_drain.go`, `test/extended-priv/mco_machineconfigpool.go`|The tests capture the existing MCP spec before setting `maxUnavailable` and defer restoring the full spec instead of removing only the override.| **Estimated code review effort:** 1 (Trivial) | ~2 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 15
✅ Passed checks (15 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The PR only changes maxUnavailable cleanup; the touched Ginkgo titles are static string literals and no dynamic title construction was introduced. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | The PR only swaps maxUnavailable cleanup to deferred spec restore; both tests already have bounded Eventually/Consistently calls, cleanup, and meaningful assertions. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo tests or unsupported API usage were added; only cleanup of existing MCO e2e tests changed. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Touched tests either already skip SNO/Compact or skip when worker count is too low; the PR only changes maxUnavailable cleanup, not cluster assumptions. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only test cleanup changed; no manifests/controllers/scheduling constraints were added, and the modified maxUnavailable restore is topology-neutral. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | Only deferred cleanup changed inside It blocks; no main/init/TestMain/BeforeSuite/AfterSuite/RunSpecs stdout writes or logging-to-stdout setup were added in the touched files. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only maxUnavailable cleanup changed in two existing MCO tests; no IPv4 literals, host/IP parsing, or external network access appears in the touched test bodies. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | Changed lines only adjust test cleanup around maxUnavailable; scans found no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/3DES/Blowfish/ECB or secret-comparison code. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | The PR only changes two Go test files; no K8s manifest paths or privilege flags (privileged/hostNetwork/etc.) appear in the diff. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ✅ Passed | No new logging was added; the changes only restore MCP spec via helpers that don’t print the spec payload. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly summarizes the main change: extended tests now restore the initial maxUnavailable after modification. |
